text: Only the card AP values were switched to their 1st-edition numbers; every other rule stayed at the 2nd-edition settings, on the same seeds. Imperator (level 3) beat Concilium in 41% of 300 games (38% with the assumed 2nd-edition values; Roman VP +0.20 ± 0.17), Imperator beat the Lookahead player in 34% of 120 (28%; +0.24 ± 0.35 VP), and Concilium under the standard rules beat the Lookahead player in 89% of 120 (93%; Roman VP +0.34 ± 0.39).
